headline: Jamalpur: 100 students took 2025 exam by mistake
summary: Regular students at Alok Mahmud College were accidentally given the question papers of 2025 irregular students.
details: Approximately 100 regular students in Jamalpur were accidentally given the question papers intended for irregular students of the 2025 batch.
The incident occurred at Alok Mahmud College, where students were sitting for their examinations.
The mix-up happened when the question papers for the 2025 irregular students were distributed to the regular 2026 batch students.
The error was discovered after the exam was completed, leading to confusion and concern among the students and parents.
College authorities are now looking into the matter to determine the how the mistake occurred and how to resolve the impact on the students' grades.
caption:
100 students just sat for an exam they weren't supposed to take. A massive mix-up in Jamalpur has left them in limbo.

Approximately 100 regular students in Jamalpur were accidentally given the question papers intended for irregular students of the 2025 batch.

The incident occurred at Alok Mahmud College, where students were sitting for their examinations.

The mix-up happened when the question papers for the 2025 irregular students were distributed to the regular 2026 batch students.

The error was discovered after the exam was completed, leading to confusion and concern among the students and parents.

College authorities are now looking into the matter to determine the how the mistake occurred and how to resolve the impact on the students' grades.

#Jamalpur #Education #ExamMixup #Bangladesh #StudentNews

Source: Somoy News, Jamuna TV
tweet: 100 students in Jamalpur accidentally took the 2025 exam instead of their own. A massive mix-up at Alok Mahmud College has left them in limbo. #Jamalpur #Education #Bangladesh

headline_marked: Cristiano Ronaldo [[sends heartwarming message to child]] injured in Venezuela earthquake
headline: Cristiano Ronaldo sends heartwarming message to child injured in Venezuela earthquake
summary: The football star reached out to a teenager who lost a leg during the natural disaster, offering support and encouragement.
details: Football legend Cristiano Ronaldo has sent a touching message of support to a young boy in Venezuela who was severely injured during a recent earthquake.
The teenager, who reportedly lost a leg due to the disaster, received a personalized video message from the star, bringing hope to the child during his recovery process.
Ronaldo's gesture has been widely praised as a heartwarming example of how sports icons can use their global influence to provide emotional strength to those in need.
The message was shared online, showing the athlete's empathy toward the victims of the earthquake and the resilience of the young survivor.
caption:
A gesture of hope: Cristiano Ronaldo reaches out to a teenager who lost a leg in a Venezuela earthquake.

Football legend Cristiano Ronaldo has sent a touching message of support to a young boy in Venezuela who was severely injured during a recent earthquake.

The teenager, who reportedly lost a leg due to the disaster, received a personalized video message from the star, bringing hope to the child during his recovery process.

Ronaldo's gesture has been widely praised as a heartwarming example of how sports icons can use their global influence to provide emotional strength to those in need.

The message was shared online, showing the athlete's empathy toward the victims of the earthquake and the resilience of the young survivor.

#CristianoRonaldo #Venezuela #Hope #Football #Humanity

Source: Somoy News, Jamuna TV
